description: $0.25 entry rung of the Agent Workforce Early-Warning Report: agent:human hours (40 h/week parity + measured engaged) and human-wait share with the > 30 min wait exclusion, computed deterministically over YOUR OWN Claude Code transcript bundle with the method of Anthropic's ‘How employment is changing at Anthropic’ (2026-10-16). Zero LLM, zero network; only the bundle's sha256 is retained. Upgrade to ops.agent-workforce-report ($25) for reading load, meta-work share, skill use and the full parity notes. Bundle cap: 4 MB per request on this endpoint. Delivered as a written Markdown report (`output`) beside the `metrics` JSON; the optional git_log / decisions / instructions inputs of the $25 report are ignored at this tier. Sending more than 4 MB of transcripts, or do not want to send them at all? Run the free local extractor https://craigmbrown.com/blindoracle/tools/workforce_extract.py (sha256 34f33389a564555e4d4476b86982feff10ca53eb6143bbc38139798d8dd09417) and send its `summary` instead of `records`: counts only, no message text, any number of days, identical numbers. The report then states that it was computed from a buyer-run extraction and whether your extractor matches the published hash; the attestation proves that input produced this output, not that the input is complete. (x402: $0.25 USDC per call)
